You will develop your knowledge of recipes, machine operation and food preparation while working closely with your colleagues to complete each order on time and to the required quality standards.Who are we looking for?- Experience in food production, a bakery, a kitchen or a similar production environment is preferred;- Technical aptitude and a willingness to learn how to operate production machines;- The ability to follow recipes and work instructions independently;- An accurate way of working, with attention to food hygiene and product quality;- A flexible attitude and a willingness to support your colleagues;- Enthusiasm for varied, hands-on production work;- The ability to maintain a steady production pace without compromising quality;- A good command of Dutch and/or English to understand instructions and communicate with colleagues;- Knowledge of HACCP and food safety is a plus, with the opportunity to learn on the job.
